name: switched-startup-from-zero
title: DC/DC startup from an empty bus
purpose: Bus discharged (0 V), 20 kΩ test load, STARTUP from t = 0. Checks the first 50 ms: the total current reference stays within the 0.25 A STARTUP clamp (ADR 0003), leg-1 current stays below the 8 A trip at every electrical step, and leg 2 stays off.
